A woman, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with 223 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Better close to the fire today.

Nora and A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm are comparing scars like trading cards.

Ivy has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm drew tiny white flowers, trifoliate leaves, thumbnail-sized red berries in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

You catch fragments by the fire — Nora telling A woman, maybe 20s, with restless hands about A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Gertrude about Nora. The retelling is already better than the event.
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.

🌱 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~9 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (3 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Nora about herself. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Jovan about Nora. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Gertrude telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
🎒 "Out past the ridge," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says, already walking. "If I'm not back in a few days... well. I'll be back."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sets out with Jovan — the fire marks the trail.

🔥 The fire settles. Mia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A boulder with opinions about where you're walking — I put it down today." "It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else." "It seals itself. The shell clicks shut — nearly invulnerable. Wait it out, or flip it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra mutters "So it bleeds." the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🛡️ Nora, Zoey, the woman in her 40s, with a slouched posture, the social worker and Ivy met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Nora, Zoey, the woman in her 40s, with a slouched posture, the social worker, Ivy are hurt.
🛡️ Nora, Gertrude, Zoey, Prisca and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Nora, Gertrude, Prisca, Petra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Nora, Elena, Zoey, Petra and Adaeze met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nora, Elena, Zoey, Petra, Adaeze are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
